hero.headline: EVERY EURO, ON THE RECORD.
hero.sub: Give to people and charities you can check. Your donation waits in a locked account and is paid out in steps, only after donors approve the receipts.
hero.trustNote: Pay by card, Apple Pay or crypto wallet. You can follow your euro until it is spent.

howItWorks.title: How it works

donate.title: You donate
donate.body: By card, Apple Pay or crypto wallet. You get an email receipt and a link to follow your money.

milestones.title: The money is locked
milestones.body: It waits in a locked account. Nobody, including us, can send it anywhere except the campaign, back to donors, or the Emergency Pool.

proof.title: Donors approve, money moves
proof.body: Charities get the money in 3 steps. Each next step is paid only after donors approve the receipts for the last one.

howItWorks.belowNote: If a campaign doesn't reach 10% of its goal, you choose: get your money back, or send it to the Emergency Pool.

campaigns.title: Campaigns raising now
campaigns.daysLeft: {count, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}}
campaigns.seeAllDonations: See all {count} donations on the blockchain

charityMarketCap.heading: How does your charity score?
charityMarketCap.description: One public Trust Score for every charity: donor ratings, receipts delivered on time, campaigns that reached their goal. The formula is open. Charities not on CHERR.IO yet are listed too.

emergencyPool.heading: Ready before disaster strikes.
emergencyPool.description: Money from campaigns that fell short, and direct gifts, wait here. When a flood or fire hits, donors vote within 24 hours on where it goes.

account.anonymousDonationsHint: When enabled, your display name will be hidden from public donation records on the website.
